description: This file contains shell script functions and commands for managing OpenClaw via Docker, including start/stop/restart operations, configuration, health checks, device management, and user guidance.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Styled output for commands in green and bold

methods.description: Inline command formatting in green and bold
